description: This Java source file defines the PaymentMethodServices class, providing service methods for managing payment methods, including creation, update, deletion, and expiration handling for various payment entities such as CreditCard, GiftCard, EftAccount, and CheckAccount within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: PaymentMethodServices
classes.description: A class providing static service methods for managing payment methods and related entities such as CreditCard, GiftCard, EftAccount, and CheckAccount within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: deletePaymentMethod
methods.description: Marks a PaymentMethod as expired by setting its 'thruDate' to the current timestamp, with security checks for user permissions.

methods.name: makeExpireDate
methods.description: Constructs an expiration date string from month and year inputs.

methods.name: createCreditCard
methods.description: Creates new CreditCard and PaymentMethod entities with validation and contact mechanism association.

methods.name: updateCreditCard
methods.description: Updates existing CreditCard and PaymentMethod entities, handling masking, validation, and contact mechanism updates.

methods.name: clearCreditCardData
methods.description: Clears sensitive credit card data and expires the associated payment method.

methods.name: createGiftCard
methods.description: Creates new GiftCard and PaymentMethod entities with validation.

methods.name: updateGiftCard
methods.description: Updates existing GiftCard and PaymentMethod entities, handling masking, validation, and contact mechanism updates.

methods.name: createEftAccount
methods.description: Creates new EftAccount and PaymentMethod entities with validation and contact mechanism association.

methods.name: updateEftAccount
methods.description: Updates existing EftAccount and PaymentMethod entities, handling validation and contact mechanism updates.

methods.name: createCheckAccount
methods.description: Creates new CheckAccount and PaymentMethod entities with validation.

methods.name: updateCheckAccount
methods.description: Updates existing CheckAccount and PaymentMethod entities, with validation and contact mechanism updates.
